verdict.rationale: An independent probe got HTTP 200 for a root llms.txt at developer.playcanvas.com, and another probe found a large llms-full.txt (about 2 MB of complete docs). PlayCanvas also publishes per-product llms.txt files for React, Web Components, SuperSplat, SplatTransform, PCUI and the Editor. Agent-oriented material goes further: PlayCanvas Skills ship in new projects to give AI coding agents development and verification workflows, and the Editor docs point agents to the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
